# Pull request checklist

- [ ] `npm run typecheck` passes
- [ ] `npm test` passes (new core logic ships with tests)
- [ ] `npm run build` succeeds
- [ ] No paid/key-gated APIs introduced
- [ ] No fabricated fallback data — upstream failures surface as failures
- [ ] Docs (README/CONTRIBUTING) updated if behavior or setup changed
